ground.base_color: RGBA8 sRGB hardware decode; linear-area averaged sRGB reencoded mip levels
ground.normal: RGBA8 linear; mip normals renormalized; rotated tangent components inversely rotated
ground.orm: RGBA8 linear AO-Roughness-Metallic; linear area mip levels
ground.hex: mmikk TriangleGrid, candidate centers and offset/rotation adaptation; shared transformed gradients and weights for all channels
ground.rotation: bounded float phase replaces overflow-prone integer product; presentation only
ground.physical_scale: locked Poly Haven physical_size_m; independent of camera
ground.decoder: pinned bimg byte-preserving PNG decode; do not route linear channels through OS colour management

sky.lower_hemisphere: mirrored upper radiance fades to 0.28; source ground excluded
sky.specular: GGX importance-prefilter V=N, 128 Hammersley samples, N.L normalization and PDF-derived solid-angle source mip; 512x256 roughness chain
sky.tone_mapping: fixed ACES approximation then gamma; no automatic exposure
sky.brdf: analytic split-sum BRDF approximation, Fresnel energy-sharing diffuse/specular
sky.mean_water: orthographic reflection uses the same constant view direction as ground; perspective reflection uses pixel view rays

geometry: single immutable full-source world sampler; complete conforming domain grid with fine camera patch; identical renderer for game and orthographic preview; parallel rays and parallel eye vectors for orthographic views
water: infinite analytic fixed-level plane in sky-ray shader; genuine GPU presentation, static mean water only; Abyssal FFT native port deferred
shader_compiler: pinned bgfx shaderc from data/native_dependencies.lock.json; build native host Metal or D3D11 binary
asset_host: GitHub ground-sky-sources-v1 Release; processed bytes reproduced locally and bundled
presentation_recipe: backend-independent shader source SHA, renderer/byte-preserving decoder algorithm source SHA and algorithm version; compiled shader SHA independently embedded in generated runtime admission header
image_cache: independent SHA of actual RGBE/SH/GGX function AST, image recipe and locked source bytes; image byte SHA required; one exact previous-script-and-AST compatible migration
